title: Coverage Months Already Met Out of Money Standing on the Medical Plan Bill
content:
Money left standing on a member's Medicare Advantage Health Plans bill may already have met coverage months on one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders. How many is settled as follows.

## The rule

1. Where the money left standing on the medical plan bill comes to at least one month's rider premium, the coverage months already met are the whole months that money covers at the monthly rider premium the rider held carries.
2. Where that bill carries money received against it and the money left standing on it comes to less than one month's rider premium, no coverage month is met out of it.
3. Otherwise, the coverage months already met are the number of payments posted to the rider premium account.

## The money left standing on the bill

The money left standing on the medical plan bill is what has been paid on that Medicare Advantage Health Plans enrollment's premium account less the medical plan premium charged on it, and is never less than nothing.

## Condition and count

| The money left standing on the medical plan bill | Money received on that bill | Coverage months already met |
|---|---|---|
| At least one month's rider premium | Either | The whole months it covers at the monthly rider premium the rider held carries |
| Less than one month's rider premium | Yes | None |
| Less than one month's rider premium | No | The number of payments posted to the rider premium account |

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

Take a rider whose monthly rider premium is 28.60 USD, with 2 payments posted to its rider premium account.

- **Money left standing of 90.00 USD:** that is at least one month's rider premium, and it covers 3 whole months at 28.60 USD each; 3 coverage months are already met.
- **Money left standing of 28.60 USD:** that is at least one month's rider premium, and it covers 1 whole month; 1 coverage month is already met.
- **Money left standing of 15.00 USD, the bill carrying money received against it:** that is less than one month's rider premium, and no coverage month is met out of it.
- **Money left standing of nothing, the bill carrying no money received against it:** the coverage months already met are the number of payments posted to the rider premium account, that is 2.

Only whole months count: 90.00 USD at 28.60 USD a month covers 3 whole months, the remaining 4.20 USD covering no further month.
